## Summary

Here are trelliscope displays displaying the results of a study on unsupervised semantic segmentation 
algorithms. The "dimension reduction" and "blur" displays include studies of the 
effects of dimension reduction and blurring on segmentation algorithms, using a subset
of 10 kidney images. The "kidney" display includes all segmented images on 30
kidney images, and the "root" display includes all segmented images on 25
root tip images. The "whole image" represents a case where segmentation was performed
on the whole kidney image once, as opposed to segmentation occuring on a tile by
tile basis.
